technology_name: A Micronutrient Composition for Ginger and a Process for Its Preparation (Soils with pH Above Seven)
problem_solved: Micronutrient deficiencies in ginger cultivated in alkaline soils
description: Micronutrient composition developed for ginger cultivation in soils with pH above seven. The formulation is designed to address nutrient deficiencies associated with alkaline soil conditions and support crop growth.
applications:
Micronutrient fertilizer and specialty plant nutrition manufacturers
Ginger cultivation and commercial spice farming enterprises
Agricultural input companies and crop nutrition service providers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and spice grower cooperatives
Government agriculture departments and soil fertility management programs
